newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS 1Q SALES UP, PROFIT DOWN.
newsitem.headline: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS 1Q SALES UP, PROFIT DOWN.

text.p: Lithuanian cardboard maker Medienos Plaushas saw its first quarter net profit fall slightly while its sales increased, the company's chief accountant, Danute Urboniene, said on Tuesday.
"Our first quarter net profit was almost the same as it was for the same period last year, 834,000 litas compared to 867,000 litas," Urboniene told Reuters.
She added that 1Q sales had increased to 11.1 million litas from 9.8 million litas last year.
"We have reduced sales prices to compete in the market, and that explains why our profit fell a bit while our sales went up," she said.
"We plan to increase our sales in the second quarter by around five percent," she said.
"We are also considering further price reductions," she added.
The company is one of four included on the official list of the Vilnius bourse.
Its price on Monday rose to 13.95 litas from 13.10 litas.
